notes: v0: 12 trajectories from 4 public UCI datasets (CC-BY-4.0), 3 runs each (analysis/baseline, linear model, tree ensemble), every score measured on a real 80/20 holdout in the local sandbox. generated_code per record is the shared solution script for that competition plus the variant invocation line; records differ in task, reasoning, model, score and execution output. competition_id values are public-dataset task IDs (UCI-sourced), NOT official Kaggle leaderboard competitions: Kaggle competition downloads require authentication, which was unavailable, so the underlying public UCI datasets were used instead. No held-out benchmark IDs appear. Raw files are NOT committed; sha256 values above are of the local raw downloads.
